text: いまや　かれこそ　ポケモン　リーグ　しんの　チャンピオン　なのだ！

structure.en: he is the very one who

structure.jp: ポケモン　リーグ　しんの　チャンピオン　なのだ！
structure.en: is the true Pokémon League Champion!

patterns.name: 〜こそ
patterns.explanation: こそ after a word puts a spotlight on it: 'this one and no other'. かれこそ = 'he is the very one'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.span: チャンピオン　なのだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end gives the statement the feel of explaining or driving a fact home; after a noun it becomes なのだ. チャンピオン　なのだ = 'he is the Champion, you see'.
